caribbean.headline: Showery Conditions Near Roatan, Moderate Seas
caribbean.paragraph: Roatan is experiencing sustained easterly winds near 18 kt, seas to 3.9 ft with an ENE-dominant swell at a 7 s period and 75% rain probability. I am monitoring these conditions for impacts to port operations and small-craft transit, noting Barbados as the secondary concern with lighter winds near 12 kt and generally lower seas.

mediterranean.headline: Showers and Moderate Seas Affect Marseille Today
mediterranean.paragraph: Marseille is experiencing winds near 16 kt with waves to 2.9 ft and a 5 s dominant WSW swell, and the port has 50% rain probability today. I advise mariners and port operations that conditions remain below Small Craft Advisory thresholds while Barcelona reports lighter winds around 13 kt, so monitor for brief showers and short-period chop.
